logp.method_description: LogP measurement: 20 μL of the sample (10 mM) was added to a mixture containing 2 mL of water-saturated octanol and 2 mL of octanol-saturated water. The solutions were shaken in the dark at 4 °C for 24 h. After this time, the octanol and water phases were separated. The Ir content in each phase was determined by ICP-MS and the results compared with the Ir references. The LogP value was calculated using the following equation: LogP = c(Irₒ) / c(Irw) where: c(Irₒ) = Ir concentration in the octanol phase c(Irw) = Ir concentration in the water phase
